text:
anya: Quick midday sync from me — short (what I did / blockers / today) because EU legal needs updates by EOD.

- Did: ran contract demo with Acero procurement, confirmed pricing tier, walked through Dedicated throughput numbers.
- Blockers: legal asked for KMS key rotation policy + proof of HSM boundary; SE needs a short KMS requirements doc from infra. Also waiting on PO timeline (finance).
- Today: follow up with infra (KMS snippet), ping legal for exact wording, prep demo replay for execs. :spiral_calendar:

matt: Thanks anya. Quick answers:
- Finance: PO likely week of 5/12 per kevin (cc)
- For KMS, we have an existing playbook excerpt, I can share the minimal snippet. Do you want it redacted for customer? :white_check_mark:

devon: FYI from SE side — Acero asked if we support customer-managed keys in Dedicated vs Redwood-managed keys in Private. Short answer: Private supports CMK via KMS integration; Dedicated is on request (needs HSM review). Will draft one-liner for legal.

anya: @devon yes please — one-liner + a short bulleted FAQ would be perfect.

rachel: Legal/security note: for EU deployments we need to confirm key residency and key rotation schedule. For HSM attestation, we can provide the cert bundle but need to scrub any internal hostnames. I'll coordinate with infra.

kevin: Finance update: if they sign a 12-month reserved commit we can push invoice terms to Net45. If they go month-to-month, it's Net15. Will confirm Monday but seems promising.

matt: @anya attaching the KMS snippet below, redacted. Use the second paragraph for legal.

```
KMS integration (redacted):
- Customer-managed keys supported via standard KMS APIs (AES-256 envelope encryption).
- Key rotation: recommended annually; automated rotation available on Private deployments.
- HSM boundary: FIPS-140-2 validated module; attestation available upon NDA.
```

anya: Nice — will forward to legal and Acero.

devon: Small SE blocker: the onboarding guide we gave them references a beta flag for prefix caching. We need to confirm if that GA flag is allowed for Dedicated customers — otherwise I'll remove instructions.

rachel: That flag is GA for hosted but not for Dedicated. For Dedicated we need a config toggle and an ops checklist. I'll add it to the security runbook and ping eng-infra.

anya: Action items for today:
- @matt: send final redacted KMS snippet to legal (done)
- @rachel: confirm attestation packaging and residency text
- @devon: update onboarding guide to remove beta flag or add caveat
- @kevin: confirm PO timing and payment terms
I'll follow up with Acero after legal replies. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

sec-bot: Reminder: create a ticket in sec-triage for HSM attestation documentation if not already created. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/SEC-4821

kevin: created SEC-4821 and linked to the deal record.
